# Implementation report — task #2278 (implementer, round 1)

**Task:** make the pod `python` shim uv-free so uv interpreter discovery can never futex-deadlock a lock-holding `uv sync` on pod venv rebuilds; plus the plan's companion guards, gotchas entry, and dual-writer test pins.
**Status:** SUCCESS
**Branch:** `issue-2278` (pushed) — **Commit:** `37e7ba8ffc7c91a276c26918bcaf894bda13d344` (verbatim `git rev-parse HEAD`)
**Diff:** +218 / −13 across 4 files.

### What changed

- `scripts/bootstrap_pod.sh` (+72/−4):
  - **Step-6 shim rewrite (plan change 1, LOAD-BEARING):** the `PYEOF` heredoc body no longer contains any `uv` token. It execs `/workspace/explore-persona-space/.venv/bin/python` when executable, else emits a one-line stderr WARN and falls back through `command -v` over `/usr/bin/python3.11` → `python3.11` → `python3`, else exits 1 with a loud ERROR. The `PATH` export gains `/workspace/explore-persona-space/.venv/bin` prepended (console-script parity with `uv run`); the #1172 `PYTHONPATH` export and the `cd` are kept verbatim.
  - **Post-install self-test (change 2a):** `if ! /usr/local/bin/python -c "import sys; print(sys.executable)"; then ... exit 1; fi` immediately after `chmod +x` — the failure branch exits 1 explicitly (the Step-6 remote payload has no `set -e`; `ssh_cmd` propagates only the last command's status).
  - **Step-5 dangling-`.venv`-symlink guard (change 2b):** `if [ -L .venv ] && [ ! -e .venv ]; then rm -f .venv; fi` (with a stderr WARN) immediately before `uv sync --locked`.
  - **`UV_PYTHON` rc-file pin (change 2c, fail-soft defense-in-depth):** a separately-guarded (`grep -q "^export UV_PYTHON="` — deliberately NOT `grep -qF`, which must stay unique at the #1794 site) block deriving the base interpreter from the live venv via `sys._base_executable or sys.base_prefix + "/bin/python3"` (escaped double quotes; the single-quoted payload forbids apostrophes), written only when the resolved path is executable, else skipped with a WARN.
  - Stale operator string at old line 576 updated (`(exec uv run python)` → `(execs the project venv interpreter directly)`); the shim's leading comments now document the deadlock mechanism and name the second writer.
- `scripts/pod_lifecycle.py` (+31/−5): `_UV_RESTORE_SNIPPET`'s shim heredoc (the SECOND writer, run by `_restore_uv_on_pod` on every `pod.py resume` — the overlay wipe makes `[ ! -x /usr/local/bin/python ]` true, so the pre-fix snippet resurrected the deadlocking shim on every resumed pod) now carries the byte-identical uv-free body, INCLUDING the `#1172 PYTHONPATH` export this copy had drifted to omit. `set -eu`, the uv reinstall, the `uv`/`uvx` symlinks, and the presence guard are untouched.
- `.claude/rules/gotchas.md` (+1 bullet, 187,658 B total — under the 200,000 B warn cap): the three-stacked-traps entry in the MooseFS cluster (placed directly after the FUSE READ-wedge entry its discriminator references): trap 1 shim deadlock (mechanism, fresh-bootstrap-safe vs post-bootstrap `uv.lock` delta, the TWO writers, the transitional pre-fix-pod residual incl. the re-bootstrap-is-not-a-heal correction, the `futex_wait_queue`/fast-read discriminator vs the #1689 wedge, the manual `--python /usr/bin/python3.11` pin); trap 2 errno-116 on FRESH venvs (+ the 1.3 MB/s serialized-install figure); trap 3 the overlay-venv recovery (uv-pip caveat, flash-attn re-add, the stop/resume dangling-`.venv` caveat the runbook lacks). Grounded in `.claude/agent-memory/experimenter/feedback_pod_venv_rebuild_overlay_runbook.md`. `LESSONS.md` deliberately NOT edited (no rule file added; the gotchas trigger row is 19 B under its grandfather cap).
- `tests/test_bootstrap_pod_path.py` (+127/−4): new `_shim_heredoc_bodies()` helper extracting the `PYEOF` body from BOTH writers (asserts exactly one heredoc per file, so a second heredoc cannot silently retarget the pins); six new/replacement pins — `test_python_shim_does_not_invoke_uv` (regex `\buv\b` over both bodies; the #2278 regression pin), `test_python_shim_execs_project_venv_interpreter` (replaces the stale `test_python_shim_execs_uv_run_python`), `test_python_shim_preserves_pythonpath_and_cwd` (pins the pod_lifecycle PYTHONPATH drift closed), `test_shim_self_test_present`, `test_shim_self_test_fails_loud` (explicit `exit 1`, no `|| true` / `2>/dev/null` muffling), `test_dangling_venv_symlink_guard_present` (guard precedes the `uv sync --locked 2>&1 | tail -5` invocation — anchored on the invocation line, not the step-5 banner that echoes the same phrase). `test_pythonpath_python_shim_exports_before_exec` re-anchored from `exec uv run python` to `exec /workspace/explore-persona-space/.venv/bin/python` (intent — export precedes exec — unchanged).

### Why

`/usr/local/bin/python` is the first `python` on the default non-interactive-SSH PATH; uv's interpreter discovery executes PATH candidates as `<candidate> -c "<get_interpreter_info probe>"`. The pre-fix body `exec uv run python "$@"` therefore re-entered uv, and the nested `uv run` blocked on the project lock the parent `uv sync` held — a silent futex deadlock (stacked probes, zero output) on ANY pod whose checked-out branch changes `uv.lock` post-bootstrap (observed live on pod-2225-fu1, 2026-08-13). Removing every uv token from the shim makes the deadlock unreachable BY CONSTRUCTION (uv sets no reliable discovery-probe marker, so any "am I being probed" heuristic would be fragile). The second writer had to change in the same round or `pod.py resume` would reinstall the deadlock on every resumed pod (round-1 critic blocker 1). The rc-file `UV_PYTHON` pin is defense-in-depth only — it cannot reach the incident surface (non-interactive SSH sources no rc file), which is why the shim rewrite is the load-bearing layer (plan § Root-cause analysis).

Stated deviation (per plan change 1): the shim no longer performs uv's implicit `uv.lock`→venv sync as a side effect of running `python`. Interpreter identity, `sys.path` (repo root prepended), and cwd are unchanged; the dropped implicit sync IS the defect. Callers wanting a sync keep calling `uv run` / `uv sync` explicitly.
